FLARE LAB

1. Drag the orange LIGHT point and the cyan FLARE ANCHOR directly on
   the picker at the top of Flare Render. Ghost spacing follows the
   distance between the two points.
2. Build the flare in the editor below it: + add, then the
   pos / size / opac sliders. The small arrow on a row opens the full
   parameter set (color, dispersion, count chains, textures...).
3. presets loads shipped looks; save... writes your own next to them.
   The gear reveals the node's advanced inputs (detection, occlusion,
   raw point coordinates).
4. The depth branch keeps the flare occluded when the light hides
   behind the pillar - drag the light behind it and render.
5. flare_pass output is the flare over black for external compositing.

The panels hide below ~50% zoom - that is a ComfyUI DOM widget rule,
zoom back in and they return.
